note: S81 / ADR-043: the WebChat test customer the workbench 入口 page enters with a one-time ticket. Three governed steps (docs/release/run-entry-tickets.md §2): identity_human goes to the identity operator exactly as identity-human.example.json (username entry-test-consumer; the password is generated and goes only to the Keychain and the host's private secrets, never here); webchat_consumers to nexloop_eios.webchat_consumers --apply; then business_setup with business-recipe.example.json (human_principal_id = <PRINCIPAL_ID>) creates the Consumer, its EffectControl and the ConsumerOwnership - logging in or opening a conversation does not create a Consumer. The owner then marks the Consumer simulated_agent (erase_synthetic_consumer.py mark, ADR-034) before the switch is turned on: the entry ticket refuses any other target, and the outreach candidates skip it. Then ENTRY_TEST_WEBCHAT_PRINCIPAL=<PRINCIPAL_ID> in the private compose env. Synthetic placeholders only.
